text: The twenty-five tattvas, namely the principle of knowledge (prameya), the supreme principle (pradhana), intellect (buddhi), ego (ahamkara), the five subtle elements (panchatanmatras), the eleven sense organs (ekadashendriyani), the five great elements (panchamahabhutani), and the individual self (purusha), are said to be the manifest, unmanifest, and the knower.
